svg.title: Тяга гири одной рукой — положение 1
svg.desc: Original ImageGen hollow contour, vector traced. One-arm bent-over kettlebell row. Three-quarter side view, same stable split stance and hips hinged, near-horizontal straight back. Working hand holds exactly ONE distinct round kettlebell with rounded loop handle; free hand braces on front thigh in both phases. Start left: kettlebell hangs directly below shoulder from straight arm. Finish right: working elbow flexed and drawn back next to ribs, kettlebell raised to side of waist. Torso does not rotate. No dumbbell, no second kettlebell and no machinery. Expert biomechanics approval pending.
